# Meridale Pilot Kickoff 2025-06-02

Three Meridale clinics went live on Quaylane 2.7 as a paid pilot. The start of the account that shaped most of 2026.

## What happened

- Kickoff call at 08:00 with Victoria Ashdown, Joanne Pruett and the three clinic leads; Renata, Imani and I on our side. Dana had negotiated a six-month pilot at a flat $9,000.
- Each clinic ran as a separate Quaylane account, because multi-site support did not exist yet. Joanne's clinic imported its appointment book from CSV; the other two started from empty books and ran both systems for two weeks.
- First-day issues: room names over 40 characters truncated on the day view (fixed the same evening, `QL-812`), and one clinic's opening hours entered in the wrong time zone during setup.

## What we learned

- A clinic group thinks in sites, not accounts. Joanne had three browser tabs open by 10:00. That observation became [[multi-location-calendars]].
- Meridale's IT team would want SSO and a security review before any wider rollout. Samir Haddad said so in the first week; the questionnaire arrived on 2025-09-15 ([[meridale-security-questionnaire]]).
- Front-desk staff phoned down a waitlist on paper after every cancellation. That fed [[waitlist-autofill]].

## Follow-up

- Pilot extended in 2025-12 while the contract was negotiated; signed on 2026-01-12, see [[meridale-contract-signed-2026-01-12]].
- Pilot results are summarized in [[meridale-pilot-report-2025-12]].
